summary: Decodes 32-bit packed luminance+alpha source texels (two 16-bit half-words per dword) into 32-bit float RGBA output: R and G both carry the luminance value, B is written as 1.0 and alpha is written as 1.0 by the loop increment. The source texel address is computed from the base pixel-data pointer (this+0x18) plus a3 times the slice stride (this+0x1054) plus a2 times the row pitch (this+0x1050), decoding *(this+0x1058) texels. The luminance half-word is scaled by 0.000015259022. When the flag at this+0x10 is non-zero, ContactManifoldCleanup (0x00507845) is invoked on the decoded output buffer afterwards.

operations.description: Source pointer v4 = *(this+0x18) + a3 * *(this+0x1054) + a2 * *(this+0x1050) locates the first dword texel of the requested row and slice.
Iterate while v4 < i where i = &v4[*(this+0x1058)]; each iteration consumes one dword texel (two 16-bit half-words) and emits 4 output floats.
First channel: a4[0] = (unsigned short)*v4 * 0.000015259022; the scale factor is supplied by the read-only float globals flt_5AD290 and flt_5ADB14.
Second channel: a4[1] = (unsigned short)(v4 - 1) * 0.000015259022 reads the second half-word of the just-consumed dword, duplicating the luminance value.
Third channel: 1.0 is written to a4[2] for every emitted pixel.
Alpha channel: the loop-increment write stores 1.0 to a4[3] for every emitted pixel.
When the flag at this+0x10 is non-zero, the decoded output buffer is post-processed.
ContactManifoldCleanup(this, &a4[-4 * *(this+0x1058)]) runs on the guard path, receiving the start of the decoded float RGBA buffer.
